gaps.sentence: If the pilot ___ the storm, we would have landed on time.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had avoided.

gaps.sentence: If only I had taken that job — I ___ much happier now.
gaps.hint: mixed wish: past event, present result
gaps.explanation: 'Now' anchors the result in the present, so 'would be' is needed.

gaps.sentence: ___ there be any problems, call this number.
He wishes he ___ harder at school when he had the chance.
gaps.hint: past regret, wish plus past perfect
gaps.explanation: Regret about past behavior takes the past perfect after 'wish': had worked.

gaps.sentence: If the drug ___ tested properly, the side effects would have been found earlier.
gaps.hint: passive verb in an unreal past condition
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect, here in the passive: had been.

gaps.sentence: We will lose the deposit if we ___ the booking now.
gaps.explanation: The result clause carries 'will'; the if-clause stays in the present simple: cancel.

gaps.sentence: If the hotel ___ a pool, we would book it for the whole team.
gaps.hint: unreal present lack of a facility
gaps.explanation: The hotel does not have a pool now, so the if-clause takes the past simple: had.

gaps.sentence: I'll lend you the tent ___ you bring it back dried.
gaps.explanation: 'Provided (that)' introduces the condition under which something will happen.
